title: The country manifest, fe/niord-country.json
description: What a country's build can serve: its applications' languages, where each language's pack comes from, per-country locales and the guarded overrides. An unknown field fails. The kit's reader (country-kit/lib/manifest.mjs) adds the rules a schema cannot say: a default among the UI languages, the administration app's UI languages among its content languages, a pack entry for every language but en, and the overrides' paths.

country.description: The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, two letters a-z: niord-<country>, tokens.<country>.css.

uiLanguages.description: The UI is offered in these; each needs the application's text in its pack, complete.

contentLanguages.description: Message content may be written in these; each needs only its pack's name and flag.

packs.description: Where each language but en comes from: pinned (a foreign pack, its digest in fe/niord-pins.lock.json) or home (in fe/packs/<lang>/).

owner.description: The GitHub owner of the pack's GHCR package; sifa-dk when absent.

publish.description: Whether the country's pack.yml publishes the pack.

locales.description: A per-country locale for a language; otherwise its pack.json's.

overrides.description: The guarded overrides (fe-country-split-plan §4.9), written by node setup.mjs --add-override and --accept-override, never by hand; normally empty. Each replaces one base product file of an application's src/app/ with the country's copy at the same path below <app>/overrides/, and records the fingerprint of every base product file the copy was made from: the file and, for a component, its template and styles. The kit's reader adds the rules a schema cannot say: `with` mirrors `file`, basedOn names `file` and only files of the same application, no file twice, no spec.

file.description: The base product file replaced, relative to its fe/.

with.description: The country's copy, relative to the country's fe/.

basedOn.description: Every base product file the copy was made from, with its fingerprint: sha256 of its bytes, CRLF read as LF.

reason.description: Why the country cannot do without the copy, plain text.

added.description: The day the override was added.
